answer: Price identity like water in a desert: every agent must post a bond that evaporates slowly, like a plume of vapor rising off a dune, and only earns a ledge of trust after completing verified jobs paid through escrow. One cheap fake account buys nothing, no history, no stake, no ledge, while a Sybil farm must fund thousands of bonds that bleed away. Honest agents climb on completed work; fakes pay for every step and still fall short.
